title: technique
description: Technique capability with inputs, protocol, rules, and outputs.

capability.description: Capability or result the technique provides.

provenance_note.description: Input and output provenance annotation; omitted from authored technique files.

items.description: Directive within the named rule group.

anyOf.description: Array of related rules grouped under this key.

additionalProperties.description: Single directive or group of related directives.

rules.description: Rule names mapped to a directive or related directives.

id.description: Stable input identifier with words separated by hyphens.

description.description: Input description, beginning with `(optional)` when the input is optional.
Component description above its first `#####` field heading.

additionalProperties.description: Description of the named entry field.

entry.description: Field identifiers mapped to descriptions for each list entry, authored as `#####` headings.

anyOf.description: Description and named fields of a list component.

components.description: Named parts of a composite input, authored as `####` headings.

source.description: Input value source annotation; omitted from authored technique files.

items.description: Named technique input with optional default and component definitions.

inputs.description: Named inputs accepted by the technique.

note.description: Brief explanation of the shared input scope.

inherited_inputs.description: Shared inputs from the workflow or group contract; omitted from authored technique files.

title.description: Block label, authored as a `###` heading.

items.description: Imperative instruction within the protocol block.

steps.description: Ordered imperative step bullets for this block.

items.description: Labeled or unlabeled group of ordered protocol instructions.

id.description: Stable output identifier with words separated by hyphens, distinct from its artifact filename.

components.description: Component identifiers mapped to descriptions or list-entry field definitions.

additionalProperties.description: Description of the named list-entry field.

entry.description: List-entry fields under `#### entry` with `#####` field headings; mutually exclusive with `components`.

name.description: Single artifact filename with an extension and optional `{variable}` placeholders; declare one output per artifact.

action.description: Whether this output creates a new artifact or updates an existing one

artifact.description: Filename and create-or-update action for a persisted output.

audience.description: Intended reader of this output or artifact: `human` by default, or `agent`.

values.description: Complete set of allowed output values, authored under `#### values`.

items.description: Allowed value for the named field.

additionalProperties.description: Nonempty set of allowed values for the named field.

fieldValues.description: Field names mapped to allowed value sets, authored as `#####` headings under `#### values`.

destination.description: Output variable name annotation when different from its identifier; omitted from authored technique files.

items.description: Named output with its structure, allowed values, and optional artifact.

outputs.description: Named outputs with optional descriptions and either components or list-entry fields.

note.description: Brief explanation of the shared output obligations.

inherited_outputs.description: Shared outputs from the workflow or group contract; omitted from authored technique files.

technique.description: Capability with its inputs, protocol, rules, and outputs.
